text: StreamingNode as delegator would be a global bottleneck, so QueryCoord owns sealed load/release, Proxy plans on StreamingNode and reduces itself, and QueryNodes apply deletes. DataView is versioned (streaming_version, compact_version); a QueryView adds a query version per shard replica. States: Preparing, Ready, Up, Down, Dropping, Dropped. Production routing is not switched yet (qviews/README.md).
